info.short_description: Prevalence among Medicare Fee for Service patients of Screening and prevention: sti.
info.long_description: Prevalence among Medicare Fee for Service patients of Screening and prevention: sti. Prevalence rates are calculated by searching for certain diagnosis codes in Medicare beneficiaries’ claims. A beneficiary is considered to have a condition if the CMS administrative data has a claim indicating that the beneficiary is diagnosed for a specific condition over the reference time period (one, two, or three years, depending on the condition chosen) or, in the case of ESRD and disability, if the reason for entitlement (original or current) is listed as disabled or ESRD in the MBSF. The definitions used are the FFS definitions, based on ICD10 codes: https://www2.ccwdata.org/documents/10280/19139421/chr-chronic-condition-algorithms.pdf

info.long_name: YRBSS: Were not tested for HIV, or were not sure (Sexual Behaviors)
info.short_description: Percent of high school students who were not tested for HIV, or were not sure.
info.long_description: Weighted percentage of U.S. high school students who were not tested for HIV, or were not sure, from the CDC Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) (topic: Sexual Behaviors; YRBSS question code: H78). Estimates are reported overall and stratified (separately) by sex, race/ethnicity, and grade; grade is mapped to approximate modal ages (9th=14, 10th=15, 11th=16, 12th=17). Missing estimates are set to 0 and flagged: pct_never_tested_hiv_suppressed = 1 marks values CDC suppressed (e.g., small sample size), and pct_never_tested_hiv_not_asked = 1 marks geography-years in which the question was not asked. Note: New York state estimates exclude New York City.

info.long_name: YRBSS: Were not tested for a sexually transmitted disease (STD) other than HIV (Sexual Behaviors)
info.short_description: Percent of high school students who were not tested for a sexually transmitted disease (STD) other than HIV.
info.long_description: Weighted percentage of U.S. high school students who were not tested for a sexually transmitted disease (STD) other than HIV, from the CDC Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) (topic: Sexual Behaviors; YRBSS question code: H79). Estimates are reported overall and stratified (separately) by sex, race/ethnicity, and grade; grade is mapped to approximate modal ages (9th=14, 10th=15, 11th=16, 12th=17). Missing estimates are set to 0 and flagged: pct_not_tested_std_suppressed = 1 marks values CDC suppressed (e.g., small sample size), and pct_not_tested_std_not_asked = 1 marks geography-years in which the question was not asked. Note: New York state estimates exclude New York City.

info.short_description: Weighted percent of high school students for the measure named in the measure column. NA when CDC suppressed the estimate. Jurisdiction-years where the question was not asked are omitted.
Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for value.
Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for value.
1 if CDC suppressed the estimate (value and CI are NA), 0 otherwise.

A beneficiary is considered to have a condition if the CMS administrative data has a claim indicating that the beneficiary is diagnosed for a specific condition over the reference time period (one, two, or three years, depending on the condition chosen) or, in the case of ESRD and disability, if the reason for entitlement (original or current) is listed as disabled or ESRD in the MBSF. The definitions used are the FFS definitions, based on ICD10 codes: https://www2.ccwdata.org/documents/10280/19139421/chr-chronic-condition-algorithms.pdf

info.long_name: YRBSS: Were not tested for HIV, or were not sure (Sexual Behaviors)
info.short_description: Percent of high school students who were not tested for HIV, or were not sure.
info.long_description: Weighted percentage of U.S. high school students who were not tested for HIV, or were not sure, from the CDC Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) (topic: Sexual Behaviors; YRBSS question code: H78). Estimates are reported overall and stratified (separately) by sex, race/ethnicity, and grade; grade is mapped to approximate modal ages (9th=14, 10th=15, 11th=16, 12th=17). Missing estimates are set to 0 and flagged: pct_never_tested_hiv_suppressed = 1 marks values CDC suppressed (e.g., small sample size), and pct_never_tested_hiv_not_asked = 1 marks geography-years in which the question was not asked. Note: New York state estimates exclude New York City.
